source.text: Τὸ λοιπὸν προσεύχεσθε, ἀδελφοί, περὶ ἡμῶν, ἵνα ὁ λόγος τοῦ κυρίου τρέχῃ καὶ δοξάζηται καθὼς καὶ πρὸς ὑμᾶς, καὶ ἵνα ῥυσθῶμεν ἀπὸ τῶν ἀτόπων καὶ πονηρῶν ἀνθρώπων, οὐ γὰρ πάντων ἡ πίστις.

records.literal_gloss: Finally pray, brothers, for us, that the word of the Lord may run and be glorified, just as also with you, \v 2 and that we may be rescued from the perverse and evil men, for not of all [is] the faith.

en.L: Finally, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may run and be glorified, just as [it was] also with you, \v 2 and that we may be delivered from perverse and evil {{gender:people|men}}, for not all [have] faith.
en.B: Finally, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, pray for us: pray that the word of the Lord may run swiftly and be glorified everywhere, as it was among you, \v 2 and that we may be rescued from perverse and wicked people, for faith is not found in everyone.
en.R: And now, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, pray for us. Pray that the Lord's message will spread quickly and be given glory everywhere, as it was among you. \v 2 Pray also that we will be rescued from bad and evil people, because not everyone has faith.

fr.L: Au reste, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, priez pour nous, afin que la parole du Seigneur coure et soit glorifiée, comme [elle l’a été] aussi chez vous, \v 2 et afin que nous soyons délivrés des {{gender:humains|hommes}} pervers et méchants, car tous n’ont pas la foi.
fr.B: Enfin, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, priez pour nous : priez pour que la parole du Seigneur fasse rapidement son chemin et soit glorifiée partout, comme elle l’a été chez vous, \v 2 et pour que nous soyons délivrés des gens pervers et mauvais, car la foi ne se trouve pas chez tout le monde.
fr.R: Et maintenant, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, priez pour nous. Priez pour que le message du Seigneur se répande vite et que partout on lui rende gloire, comme cela a été le cas chez vous. \v 2 Priez aussi pour que nous soyons délivrés des gens mauvais et méchants, parce que tout le monde n’a pas la foi.

es.L: Por lo demás, hermanos, {{plural_you:oren|orad}} por nosotros, para que la palabra del Señor corra y sea glorificada, así como [lo fue] también entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, \v 2 y para que seamos librados de {{gender:las personas perversas y malvadas|los hombres perversos y malvados}}, porque no todos [tienen] fe.
es.B: Por último, hermanos, {{plural_you:oren|orad}} por nosotros: {{plural_you:pidan|pedid}} que la palabra del Señor se extienda con rapidez y sea glorificada en todas partes, como lo fue entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, \v 2 y que seamos librados de la gente perversa y malvada, porque no todos tienen fe.
es.R: Y ahora, hermanos, {{plural_you:oren|orad}} por nosotros. {{plural_you:Pidan|Pedid}} que el mensaje del Señor se extienda pronto y que en todas partes se le dé gloria, como pasó entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. \v 2 {{plural_you:Pidan|Pedid}} también que seamos librados de la gente mala y perversa, porque no todos tienen fe.

sw.L: Mwisho, ndugu, tuombeeni, ili neno la Bwana likimbie na kutukuzwa, kama vile [lilivyokuwa] pia kwenu, \v 2 na ili tuokolewe kutoka kwa watu wapotovu na waovu, kwa maana si wote [walio na] imani.
sw.B: Mwisho, ndugu, tuombeeni: ombeni kwamba neno la Bwana lienee upesi na kutukuzwa kila mahali, kama ilivyokuwa kwenu, \v 2 na kwamba tuokolewe kutoka kwa watu wapotovu na waovu, kwa maana si kila mtu aliye na imani.
sw.R: Na sasa, ndugu, tuombeeni. Ombeni kwamba ujumbe wa Bwana uenee upesi na kupewa utukufu kila mahali, kama ulivyopewa kwenu. \v 2 Ombeni pia kwamba tuokolewe kutoka kwa watu wabaya na waovu, kwa sababu si kila mtu ana imani.

ko.L: 끝으로, {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 우리를 위하여 기도하십시오. 주님의 말씀이 여러분 가운데서처럼 달려가 영광을 받게 하시고, \v 2 우리가 비뚤어지고 악한 사람들에게서 건짐을 받게 해 달라고 [기도하십시오]. 모든 사람이 믿음을 가진 것은 아니기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 끝으로, {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 우리를 위해 기도해 주십시오. 주님의 말씀이 여러분 가운데서 그랬던 것처럼 빠르게 퍼져 나가 어디서나 영광을 받도록 기도해 주십시오. \v 2 그리고 우리가 비뚤어지고 악한 사람들에게서 구출되도록 기도해 주십시오. 모든 사람에게 믿음이 있는 것은 아니기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 이제, {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 우리를 위해 기도해 주십시오. 주님의 말씀이 여러분 가운데서 그랬던 것처럼 빨리 퍼져서 어디서나 영광을 받도록 기도해 주십시오. \v 2 또 우리가 나쁘고 악한 사람들에게서 구출되도록 기도해 주십시오. 모든 사람이 믿음을 가지고 있는 것은 아니기 때문입니다.

vi.L: Sau hết, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, hãy cầu nguyện cho chúng tôi, để lời của Chúa được lan nhanh và được tôn vinh, như đã [xảy ra] ở giữa anh chị em, \v 2 và để chúng tôi được giải cứu khỏi những người gian tà và độc ác, vì không phải mọi người đều có đức tin.
vi.B: Sau hết, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, hãy cầu nguyện cho chúng tôi: xin cho lời của Chúa được lan truyền nhanh chóng và được tôn vinh khắp nơi, như đã được tôn vinh ở giữa anh chị em, \v 2 và xin cho chúng tôi được giải cứu khỏi những người gian tà và độc ác, vì không phải ai cũng có đức tin.
vi.R: Và bây giờ, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, hãy cầu nguyện cho chúng tôi. Hãy cầu xin cho sứ điệp của Chúa được lan ra nhanh chóng và được tôn vinh khắp nơi, như đã xảy ra ở giữa anh chị em. \v 2 Cũng hãy cầu xin cho chúng tôi được giải cứu khỏi những người xấu xa và độc ác, vì không phải ai cũng có đức tin.

pt.L: Finalmente, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, orem por nós, para que a palavra do Senhor corra e seja glorificada, assim como também [aconteceu] entre vocês, \v 2 e para que sejamos livrados {{gender:das pessoas perversas e más|dos homens perversos e maus}}, porque nem todos [têm] fé.
pt.B: Finalmente, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, orem por nós: orem para que a palavra do Senhor corra depressa e seja glorificada por toda parte, como foi entre vocês, \v 2 e para que sejamos libertos de pessoas perversas e más, pois nem todos têm fé.
pt.R: E agora, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, orem por nós. Orem para que a mensagem do Senhor se espalhe depressa e receba glória em toda parte, como aconteceu entre vocês. \v 2 Orem também para que sejamos livrados das pessoas más e perversas, porque nem todo mundo tem fé.

am.L: በቀረውስ፣ {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ የጌታ ቃል በእናንተ ዘንድ ደግሞ እንደ [ሆነው] እንዲሮጥና እንዲከበር፣ \v 2 ከጠማሞችና ከክፉ ሰዎችም እንድንታደግ ስለ እኛ ጸልዩ፤ እምነት የሁሉም አይደለምና።
am.B: በመጨረሻም፣ {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ ስለ እኛ ጸልዩ፤ የጌታ ቃል በእናንተ ዘንድ እንደ ሆነው በፍጥነት እንዲሮጥና በየስፍራው እንዲከበር ጸልዩ፤ \v 2 ከጠማሞችና ከክፉ ሰዎች እንድንታደግም ጸልዩ፤ እምነት በሁሉ ዘንድ አይገኝምና።
am.R: አሁን ደግሞ፣ {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ ስለ እኛ ጸልዩ። በእናንተ ዘንድ እንደ ሆነው የጌታ መልእክት በፍጥነት እንዲዳረስና በየቦታው እንዲከበር ጸልዩ። \v 2 ደግሞም ከመጥፎና ከክፉ ሰዎች እንድንታደግ ጸልዩ፤ ምክንያቱም ሁሉም ሰው እምነት የለውም።

hi.L: अंत में, {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}, हमारे लिए प्रार्थना करो, कि प्रभु का वचन दौड़े और महिमा पाए, जैसा तुम्हारे बीच भी [हुआ], \v 2 और कि हम टेढ़े और दुष्ट मनुष्यों से छुड़ाए जाएँ, क्योंकि विश्वास सब में नहीं।
hi.B: अंत में, {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}, हमारे लिए प्रार्थना करो: प्रार्थना करो कि प्रभु का वचन तेज़ी से फैले और हर जगह उसकी महिमा हो, जैसे तुम्हारे बीच हुई, \v 2 और कि हम टेढ़े और दुष्ट लोगों से छुड़ाए जाएँ, क्योंकि विश्वास हर किसी में नहीं पाया जाता।
hi.R: और अब, {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}, हमारे लिए प्रार्थना करो। प्रार्थना करो कि प्रभु का संदेश जल्दी फैले और हर जगह उसकी महिमा हो, जैसे तुम्हारे बीच हुई। \v 2 यह भी प्रार्थना करो कि हम बुरे और दुष्ट लोगों से बचाए जाएँ, क्योंकि हर कोई विश्वास नहीं करता।

ru.L: В остальном, {{gender:братья и сёстры|братья}}, молитесь о нас, чтобы слово Господа бежало и прославлялось, как и у вас, \v 2 и чтобы мы были избавлены от извращённых и злых людей, ведь не у всех вера.
ru.B: Наконец, {{gender:братья и сёстры|братья}}, молитесь за нас: молитесь, чтобы слово Господа быстро распространялось и повсюду прославлялось, как это было у вас, \v 2 и чтобы мы были избавлены от извращённых и злых людей, ведь вера есть не у всех.
ru.R: А теперь, {{gender:братья и сёстры|братья}}, молитесь за нас. Молитесь, чтобы весть Господа быстро распространялась и повсюду получала славу, как это было у вас. \v 2 Молитесь и о том, чтобы мы были спасены от дурных и злых людей, потому что не у всех есть вера.

ja.L: 最後に、{{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、わたしたちのために祈りなさい。主の言葉が、あなたがたのところでもそうであったように、走り、栄光を受けるように。\v 2 また、わたしたちが、ひねくれた悪い人々から救い出されるように。すべての人に信仰があるわけではないからです。
ja.B: 最後に、{{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、わたしたちのために祈ってください。あなたがたのところでそうであったように、主の言葉が速やかに広まり、あがめられるように祈ってください。\v 2 また、わたしたちが、道を外れた悪い人々から救い出されるように祈ってください。だれもが信仰を持っているわけではないのです。
ja.R: それから、{{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、わたしたちのために祈ってください。主の言葉がどんどん広まって、どこでもあがめられるように祈ってください。みなさんのところでそうだったようにです。\v 2 また、わたしたちが悪い人たちから助け出されるように祈ってください。だれもが信仰を持っているわけではないからです。

uk.L: Наостанок, {{gender:брати і сестри|брати}}, моліться за нас, щоб слово Господнє бігло і прославлялося, як і у вас, \v 2 і щоб ми були визволені від лихих і злих людей, бо не всі мають віру.
uk.B: Нарешті, {{gender:брати і сестри|брати}}, моліться за нас: моліться, щоб слово Господнє швидко поширювалося і всюди було прославлене, як це сталося у вас, \v 2 і щоб ми були врятовані від розбещених і злих людей, бо віра є не в усіх.
uk.R: А тепер, {{gender:брати і сестри|брати}}, моліться за нас. Моліться, щоб Господня вістка швидко поширювалася і всюди її прославляли, як це було у вас. \v 2 Моліться також, щоб ми були врятовані від поганих і злих людей, бо не всі мають віру.

decisions.choice: finally: as for the rest
decisions.reason: λοιπὸν, as in 1 Thessalonians 4:1, turns to the closing section.

decisions.choice: may run and be glorified: spread swiftly and be honored
decisions.reason: The word of the Lord is pictured as a runner (Psalm 147:15, "his word runs swiftly"). It is glorified when people receive it as God's word, as the Thessalonians did (1 Thessalonians 2:13).

decisions.choice: perverse and evil people: particular opponents where Paul is
decisions.reason: The article points to known opponents, probably in Corinth (Acts 18:5-17).

decisions.choice: not all have faith
decisions.reason: πάντων ἡ πίστις means faith is not held by all people: not everyone believes, so the gospel meets opposition. The article may also mean "the faith", but the sense is the same. It sets up a play on words in verse 3: people may be faithless, but the Lord is faithful.

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: The letter is to the whole church, women and men; "brothers" stays available as the traditional form.

decisions.choice: {{gender:people|men}}
decisions.reason: The word means human beings in general; Balanced and Readable say "people".

decisions.choice: will spread quickly and be given glory
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of the runner (m2) and keeps the key term "glory".

decisions.choice: des {{gender:humains|hommes}} (L); des gens (B, R) (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: The word means human beings in general; Literal puts the noun under the setting with "hommes" as the traditional form, and Balanced and Readable say "les gens", as the English says "people".

decisions.choice: {{gender:las personas perversas y malvadas|los hombres perversos y malvados}}
decisions.reason: As in the English Literal, the traditional "los hombres" is offered as the alternative for the word that means people in general. The span takes in the adjectives, which agree with the noun.

decisions.choice: likimbie (L); lienee upesi (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps Paul's picture of the word running, which Swahili can say of news ("habari zinakimbia"); Balanced and Readable say it spreads quickly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "사람들" with no gender span, here and through the chapter
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "people" or "men". Korean "사람" already means people of either sex, and Korean "그 사람", "그들" need no gender span where the English Literal has one (3:6, 3:14-15).

decisions.choice: "달려가 영광을 받다" (L); "빠르게 퍼져 나가 ... 영광을 받다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek says the word may "run and be glorified", spread swiftly and be honored (the meaning decision). Literal keeps the picture of running; "영광" is the key term at every level.

decisions.choice: "lan nhanh" (L), "lan truyền nhanh chóng" (B), "lan ra nhanh chóng" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is "run" (m2). Vietnamese does not say that a word runs, so every level says that it spreads quickly, which is what the picture means.

decisions.choice: {{gender:das pessoas perversas e más|dos homens perversos e maus}}
decisions.reason: The adjectives and the article agree with the noun in Portuguese, so the whole phrase goes under the setting and each option reads correctly.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God and Christ has nothing to change in Amharic; the pronouns (እርሱ, the verb endings) are written once, with no span, through this chapter.

decisions.choice: ሰዎች / ሰው (people), with no gender span
decisions.reason: The Greek word means human beings, men and women. Amharic "ሰው" and "ሰዎች" already say that, and "ወንዶች" would wrongly mean males only, so Amharic has no span where the English has one.

decisions.choice: {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}
decisions.reason: The letter is to the whole church, women and men, so the inclusive vocative is the default, as through Paul's letters. The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: "मनुष्यों" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal has a gender span on "people". The Hindi "मनुष्य" already means people of both sexes, so there is nothing for the setting to change (style guide, section 7).

decisions.choice: "अंत में" (L, B); "और अब" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Thessalonians 4:1, "finally" turns to what remains (meaning decision m1); Readable avoids a word that sounds like the letter is ending.

decisions.choice: {{gender:братья и сёстры|братья}}
decisions.reason: As in English: the letter is to the whole church, women and men. The traditional "братья" stays available as the alternative.

decisions.choice: людей, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English Literal puts "people|men" under the gender setting. Russian "люди" is already inclusive, so the style guide sets no span.

decisions.choice: "走り、栄光を受ける" (L); "速やかに広まり、あがめられる" (B, R)
alternatives: "広まり、栄光を受ける" at every level
decisions.reason: The word is pictured as a runner, spreading swiftly and honored (m2). Literal keeps the picture; Balanced and Readable say what it means. As at 1 Thessalonians 5:25, Balanced and Readable ask for prayer with "祈ってください", since Paul is asking a favor, and Literal keeps the imperative.

decisions.choice: людей, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: As in 1 Thessalonians 2:4, Ukrainian "люди" already includes everyone, so the English span has no counterpart.

source.text: πιστὸς δέ ἐστιν ὁ κύριος, ὃς στηρίξει ὑμᾶς καὶ φυλάξει ἀπὸ τοῦ πονηροῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Faithful but is the Lord, who will strengthen you and guard from the evil [one].

en.L: But the Lord is faithful, who will strengthen you and guard [you] from the evil one.
en.B: But the Lord can be trusted: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will make you strong and guard you from the evil one.
en.R: But the Lord is faithful. He will make you strong and keep you safe from the evil one.

fr.L: Mais le Seigneur est fidèle, qui vous affermira et [vous] gardera du Mauvais.
fr.B: Mais le Seigneur est digne de confiance : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous rendra forts et vous gardera du Mauvais.
fr.R: Mais le Seigneur est fidèle. Il vous rendra forts et vous protégera du Mauvais.

es.L: Pero fiel es el Señor, que {{plural_you:los|os}} afirmará y {{plural_you:los|os}} guardará del maligno.
es.B: Pero el Señor es digno de confianza: {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:los|os}} fortalecerá y {{plural_you:los|os}} protegerá del maligno.
es.R: Pero el Señor es fiel. Él {{plural_you:los|os}} hará fuertes y {{plural_you:los|os}} protegerá del maligno.

sw.L: Lakini Bwana ni mwaminifu, ambaye atawaimarisha na kuwalinda kutoka kwa yule mwovu.
sw.B: Lakini Bwana ni wa kuaminika: atawafanya imara na kuwalinda dhidi ya yule mwovu.
sw.R: Lakini Bwana ni mwaminifu. Atawafanya imara na kuwalinda salama mbali na yule mwovu.

ko.L: 그러나 주님은 신실하시니, 그분이 여러분을 굳게 하시고 악한 자에게서 지켜 주실 것입니다.
ko.B: 그러나 주님은 믿을 수 있는 분이십니다. 그분은 여러분을 강하게 하시고, 악한 자에게서 여러분을 지켜 주실 것입니다.
ko.R: 그러나 주님은 신실하십니다. 그분은 여러분을 강하게 하시고, 악한 자에게서 여러분을 안전하게 지켜 주실 것입니다.

vi.L: Nhưng Chúa là thành tín, Đấng sẽ làm cho anh chị em vững mạnh và gìn giữ [anh chị em] khỏi kẻ ác.
vi.B: Nhưng Chúa là Đấng đáng tin cậy: {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ làm cho anh chị em vững mạnh và gìn giữ anh chị em khỏi kẻ ác.
vi.R: Nhưng Chúa là thành tín. Ngài sẽ làm cho anh chị em vững mạnh và giữ anh chị em được an toàn khỏi kẻ ác.

pt.L: Mas fiel é o Senhor, que os fortalecerá e [os] guardará do Maligno.
pt.B: Mas o Senhor é digno de confiança: {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os tornará fortes e os guardará do Maligno.
pt.R: Mas o Senhor é fiel. Ele vai dar força a vocês e vai proteger vocês do Maligno.

am.L: ጌታ ግን ታማኝ ነው፤ እርሱም ያጸናችኋል፤ ከክፉውም ይጠብቃችኋል።
am.B: ጌታ ግን የሚታመን ነው፤ ያጠነክራችኋል፤ ከክፉውም ይጠብቃችኋል።
am.R: ጌታ ግን ታማኝ ነው። ያጠነክራችኋል፤ ከክፉውም ይጠብቃችኋል።

hi.L: पर प्रभु विश्वासयोग्य हैं, जो तुम्हें दृढ़ करेंगे और उस दुष्ट से [तुम्हारी] रक्षा करेंगे।
hi.B: पर प्रभु भरोसे के योग्य हैं: वे तुम्हें मज़बूत करेंगे और उस दुष्ट से तुम्हारी रक्षा करेंगे।
hi.R: पर प्रभु विश्वासयोग्य हैं। वे तुम्हें मज़बूत करेंगे और उस दुष्ट से तुम्हें सुरक्षित रखेंगे।

ru.L: Но верен Господь, который укрепит вас и сохранит от лукавого.
ru.B: Но на Господа можно положиться: {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} укрепит вас и защитит от лукавого.
ru.R: Но Господь верен. Он сделает вас сильными и защитит вас от лукавого.

ja.L: しかし、主は真実です。その主が、あなたがたを強め、悪い者から守ってくださいます。
ja.B: しかし、主は信頼できる方です。主はあなたがたを強くし、悪い者から守ってくださいます。
ja.R: でも、主は約束を必ず守られる方です。主はみなさんを強くして、悪い者から守ってくださいます。

uk.L: Але вірний Господь, який утвердить вас і збереже від лукавого.
uk.B: Але на Господа можна покластися: {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зміцнить вас і вбереже від лукавого.
uk.R: Але Господь вірний. Він зробить вас сильними і вбереже вас від лукавого.

decisions.choice: the evil one: Satan
decisions.reason: πονηροῦ can be masculine ("the evil one") or neuter ("evil"). The source data takes it as masculine, and Paul has spoken of Satan's work in 2:9; Jesus' prayer "deliver us from the evil one" (Matthew 6:13) has the same ambiguity.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "the Lord is faithful"
decisions.reason: A few manuscripts read "God". The meaning is close (1 Thessalonians 5:24).

decisions.choice: faithful: in contrast to faithless people
decisions.reason: πιστὸς picks up "faith" in verse 2: even where people are faithless, the Lord is faithful.

decisions.choice: le Mauvais
decisions.reason: The evil one is Satan (m1, uncertain). "Le Malin" is traditional, but "malin" today mostly means clever; "le Mauvais", with a capital, names the person plainly.

decisions.choice: el maligno
decisions.reason: The project's term for "the evil one"; the footnoted meaning decision reads it as Satan rather than evil in general.

decisions.choice: "신실하시니" (L, R); "믿을 수 있는 분" (B), against "믿음" in verse 2
decisions.reason: The Lord's faithfulness is set against people who have no faith (verse 2, the meaning decision). Korean "신실하다" and "믿음" are not from one root as the Greek words are, so Balanced says "믿을 수 있는 분" (one who can be trusted), which keeps "믿다" in view, as in 1 Thessalonians 5:24.

decisions.choice: "thành tín" (L, R), "đáng tin cậy" (B) for the Lord; set against "đức tin" in verse 2
decisions.reason: Paul sets the Lord's faithfulness against those who have no faith (m3). As in 1 Thessalonians 5:24, "thành tín" is said of God; the shared "tín" lets the reader hear the play with "đức tin".

decisions.choice: o Maligno
decisions.reason: As in Matthew (13:19, 38), the name for Satan (m1) is "o Maligno" with a capital, which marks it as a person.

decisions.choice: ታማኝ / የሚታመን (faithful, trustworthy), from the same root as እምነት (faith) in verse 2
decisions.reason: Paul sets the Lord's faithfulness against the faithlessness of verse 2 with words of one root; Amharic "እምነት" and "ታማኝ" share a root too, so the contrast survives.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans; honorific forms for the Lord ("वे ... करेंगे")
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi. Respect for the Lord comes from the honorific third person at every level (style guide, sections 4 and 7). The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: "उस दुष्ट"
decisions.reason: The evil one is Satan (meaning decision m1); "उस दुष्ट" names a person, as the English "the evil one" does.

decisions.choice: "悪い者" at every level
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the evil one as Satan (m1, uncertain, footnoted). "悪い者" points to a person, as the English "the evil one" does, without naming him; "悪" would choose the other reading.

decisions.choice: лукавий
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads Satan, the evil one; "лукавий" is the Ukrainian name for him, where "зло" would mean evil in general.

source.text: πεποίθαμεν δὲ ἐν κυρίῳ ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς, ὅτι ἃ παραγγέλλομεν καὶ ποιεῖτε καὶ ποιήσετε.

records.literal_gloss: We are confident now in [the] Lord about you, that what we command both you are doing and will do.

en.L: And we are confident in [the] Lord about you, that you are doing and will do the things we command.
en.B: Because of the Lord, we are confident about you: you are doing what we tell you, and you will go on doing it.
en.R: The Lord gives us confidence that you are obeying our teaching, and that you will keep on obeying it.

fr.L: Et nous avons confiance dans le Seigneur à votre sujet, que vous faites et ferez ce que nous ordonnons.
fr.B: Grâce au Seigneur, nous avons confiance en vous : vous faites ce que nous vous disons, et vous continuerez à le faire.
fr.R: Le Seigneur nous donne confiance : nous sommes sûrs que vous obéissez à notre enseignement, et que vous continuerez à lui obéir.

es.L: Y tenemos confianza en [el] Señor respecto a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, de que {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} y {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} mandamos.
es.B: Gracias al Señor, tenemos confianza en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}: {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} decimos y lo {{plural_you:seguirán|seguiréis}} haciendo.
es.R: El Señor nos da confianza en que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:obedecen|obedecéis}} nuestra enseñanza, y en que la {{plural_you:seguirán|seguiréis}} obedeciendo.

sw.L: Nasi tuna uhakika katika Bwana kuhusu ninyi, kwamba mnafanya na mtaendelea kufanya yale tunayoagiza.
sw.B: Kwa sababu ya Bwana, tuna uhakika kuhusu ninyi: mnafanya yale tunayowaagiza, nanyi mtaendelea kuyafanya.
sw.R: Bwana anatupa uhakika kwamba mnayatii mafundisho yetu, na kwamba mtaendelea kuyatii.

ko.L: 그리고 우리가 명령하는 것을 여러분이 행하고 있고 또 행할 것을, 우리는 주님 안에서 여러분에 대하여 확신합니다.
ko.B: 주님 때문에 우리는 여러분에 대해 확신합니다. 여러분은 우리가 명령하는 것을 지금 행하고 있고, 앞으로도 계속 행할 것입니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 우리에게 확신을 주십니다. 여러분은 지금 우리의 가르침에 순종하고 있고, 앞으로도 계속 순종할 것입니다.

vi.L: Và trong Chúa, chúng tôi tin chắc về anh chị em rằng anh chị em đang làm và sẽ làm những điều chúng tôi truyền dặn.
vi.B: Nhờ Chúa, chúng tôi tin chắc về anh chị em: anh chị em đang làm những điều chúng tôi dặn bảo, và sẽ tiếp tục làm.
vi.R: Chúa cho chúng tôi lòng tin chắc rằng anh chị em đang vâng theo lời dạy của chúng tôi, và anh chị em sẽ tiếp tục vâng theo.

pt.L: E estamos confiantes no Senhor a respeito de vocês, de que vocês fazem e farão as coisas que ordenamos.
pt.B: Por causa do Senhor, temos confiança a respeito de vocês: vocês estão fazendo o que lhes mandamos e vão continuar a fazê-lo.
pt.R: O Senhor nos dá a certeza de que vocês estão obedecendo ao nosso ensino e de que vão continuar obedecendo.

am.L: ያዘዝናችሁን እያደረጋችሁ እንዳላችሁና ወደ ፊትም እንደምታደርጉ በጌታ ሆነን ስለ እናንተ እንተማመናለን።
am.B: በጌታ ምክንያት ስለ እናንተ እንተማመናለን፤ የምናዝዛችሁን እያደረጋችሁ ነው፤ ወደ ፊትም ታደርጉታላችሁ።
am.R: እናንተ ትምህርታችንን እየታዘዛችሁ እንደ ሆነና መታዘዛችሁንም እንደምትቀጥሉ ጌታ እንድንተማመን ያደርገናል።

hi.L: और हमें प्रभु में तुम्हारे विषय में भरोसा है कि जो आज्ञाएँ हम देते हैं, उन्हें तुम मानते हो और मानते भी रहोगे।
hi.B: प्रभु के कारण हमें तुम पर भरोसा है: जो कुछ हम तुमसे कहते हैं, वह तुम कर रहे हो, और करते रहोगे।
hi.R: प्रभु हमें यह भरोसा देते हैं कि तुम हमारी शिक्षा मान रहे हो, और आगे भी मानते रहोगे।

ru.L: Уверены же мы в Господе о вас, что то, что мы повелеваем, вы и делаете, и будете делать.
ru.B: Благодаря Господу мы уверены в вас: вы делаете то, что мы вам говорим, и будете делать это и дальше.
ru.R: Господь даёт нам уверенность, что вы слушаетесь нашего учения и будете слушаться его и дальше.

ja.L: わたしたちは主にあって、あなたがたについて確信しています。わたしたちが命じていることを、あなたがたは現に行っており、これからも行うであろうと。
ja.B: わたしたちは主を信頼しているので、あなたがたについても確信しています。あなたがたは、わたしたちが命じていることを行っていますし、これからも行い続けるでしょう。
ja.R: 主がわたしたちに確信を与えてくださっています。みなさんは、わたしたちの教えに従っていますし、これからも従い続けるでしょう。

uk.L: А ми впевнені в Господі щодо вас, що ви робите й робитимете те, що ми наказуємо.
uk.B: Завдяки Господу ми впевнені щодо вас: ви робите те, що ми вам кажемо, і робитимете й далі.
uk.R: Господь дає нам упевненість, що ви слухаєтеся нашого навчання і слухатиметеся й далі.

decisions.choice: confident in the Lord about you: our trust rests on the Lord, not only on you
decisions.reason: Paul's confidence about them comes from his confidence in the Lord who strengthens them (verse 3).

decisions.choice: what we command: preparing for the commands of verses 6-15
decisions.reason: παραγγέλλω is the word for giving orders; it returns in verses 6, 10 and 12.

decisions.choice: "主を信頼しているので" (B); "主がわたしたちに確信を与えてくださっています" (R)
alternatives: "主に結ばれて" as elsewhere for "in the Lord"
decisions.reason: Here "in the Lord" says where Paul's confidence rests (m1), not the readers' union with Christ, so Balanced and Readable say so, as the English does, instead of the usual "主に結ばれて".

source.text: ὁ δὲ κύριος κατευθύναι ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας εἰς τὴν ἀγάπην τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ εἰς τὴν ὑπομονὴν τοῦ Χριστοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: The now Lord may direct your hearts into the love of the God and into the endurance of the Christ.

en.L: And may the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God and into the endurance of the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: May the Lord guide your hearts into the love of God and the endurance of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.
en.R: We pray that the Lord will help you understand more and more how much God loves you, and help you keep going with patience, as {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} did.

fr.L: Et que le Seigneur dirige vos cœurs vers l’amour de Dieu et vers la persévérance du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.B: Que le Seigneur conduise vos cœurs dans l’amour de Dieu et dans la persévérance du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.R: Nous prions pour que le Seigneur vous aide à comprendre de mieux en mieux combien Dieu vous aime, et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous aide à tenir bon avec patience, comme le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} l’a fait.

es.L: Y que el Señor dirija {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} corazones hacia el amor de Dios y hacia la perseverancia del {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}.
es.B: Que el Señor guíe {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} corazones hacia el amor de Dios y la perseverancia {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}.
es.R: Pedimos que el Señor {{plural_you:los|os}} ayude a entender cada vez más cuánto {{plural_you:los|os}} ama Dios, y a seguir adelante con paciencia, como lo hizo {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}.

sw.L: Na Bwana aielekeze mioyo yenu katika upendo wa Mungu na katika uvumilivu wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Bwana aiongoze mioyo yenu katika upendo wa Mungu na uvumilivu wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.R: Tunaomba kwamba Bwana awasaidie kuelewa zaidi na zaidi jinsi Mungu anavyowapenda, na kuwasaidia kuendelea kuvumilia kwa subira, kama {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alivyovumilia.

ko.L: 주님께서 여러분의 마음을 하나님의 사랑과 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 인내로 인도하시기를 [빕니다].
ko.B: 주님께서 여러분의 마음을 이끄셔서, 하나님의 사랑과 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 인내에 이르게 해 주시기를 빕니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 여러분이 하나님께서 여러분을 얼마나 사랑하시는지 점점 더 깨닫도록 도와주시기를 기도합니다. 그리고 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 그러셨듯이 여러분도 끝까지 참고 견딜 수 있게 도와주시기를 기도합니다.

vi.L: Nguyện Chúa hướng lòng anh chị em vào tình yêu thương của Đức Chúa Trời và vào sự kiên trì của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.B: Nguyện Chúa dẫn dắt lòng anh chị em vào tình yêu thương của Đức Chúa Trời và sự kiên trì của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.R: Chúng tôi cầu xin Chúa giúp anh chị em ngày càng hiểu Đức Chúa Trời yêu thương anh chị em biết bao, và giúp anh chị em cứ kiên nhẫn bền lòng, như {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đã bền lòng.

pt.L: E [que] o Senhor dirija o coração de vocês para o amor de Deus e para a perseverança do {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}.
pt.B: Que o Senhor guie o coração de vocês para o amor de Deus e para a perseverança {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}.
pt.R: Oramos para que o Senhor ajude vocês a entender cada vez mais o quanto Deus ama vocês, e a continuar firmes com paciência, como {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} continuou.

am.L: ጌታም ልባችሁን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ፍቅርና ወደ {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ጽናት ያቅና።
am.B: ጌታ ልባችሁን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ፍቅርና ወደ {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ጽናት ይምራ።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ምን ያህል እንደሚወዳችሁ ጌታ ይበልጥ እያስረዳችሁ እንዲሄድ፣ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} እንዳደረገው እናንተም በትዕግሥት እንድትጸኑ እንዲረዳችሁ እንጸልያለን።

hi.L: और प्रभु तुम्हारे हृदयों को परमेश्वर के प्रेम और मसीह के धीरज की ओर ले चलें।
hi.B: प्रभु तुम्हारे हृदयों को परमेश्वर के प्रेम और मसीह के धीरज की ओर ले चलें।
hi.R: हम प्रार्थना करते हैं कि प्रभु तुम्हें और भी अधिक समझने में मदद करें कि परमेश्वर तुमसे कितना प्रेम करते हैं, और धीरज के साथ डटे रहने में तुम्हारी मदद करें, जैसे मसीह डटे रहे।

ru.L: Господь же да направит ваши сердца в любовь Божью и в терпение {{christos:Христа|Мессии}}.
ru.B: Пусть Господь направит ваши сердца к Божьей любви и к стойкости {{christos:Христа|Мессии}}.
ru.R: Мы молимся, чтобы Господь помог вам всё лучше понимать, как сильно Бог любит вас, и помог вам терпеливо идти вперёд, как шёл {{christos:Христос|Мессия}}.

ja.L: どうか主が、あなたがたの心を、神の愛と{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の忍耐へと導いてくださいますように。
ja.B: どうか主が、あなたがたの心を導いて、神の愛と{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の忍耐に向かわせてくださいますように。
ja.R: 主がみなさんを助けて、神がどれほどみなさんを愛しておられるかを、ますますわからせてくださるように祈っています。また、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}がそうされたように、みなさんが忍耐強く歩み続けられるように助けてくださるよう、祈っています。

uk.L: А Господь нехай скерує ваші серця до любові Божої і до стійкості {{christos:Христа|Месії}}.
uk.B: Нехай Господь провадить ваші серця до Божої любові й до стійкості {{christos:Христа|Месії}}.
uk.R: Ми молимося, щоб Господь допоміг вам дедалі краще розуміти, як сильно Бог вас любить, і допоміг вам терпляче триматися, як тримався {{christos:Христос|Месія}}.

decisions.choice: the love of God and the endurance of Christ: God's love for them, and the endurance Christ showed and gives
alternatives: their love for God and their patient waiting for Christ
decisions.reason: Both genitives can be read either way: God's love for them or theirs for God; Christ's own endurance or their patient waiting for him. Paul most likely means that they are drawn deeper into God's love for them and share the steadfastness Christ showed in suffering.

decisions.choice: direct your hearts: make a straight way for them
decisions.reason: κατευθύνω is the verb of 1 Thessalonians 3:11, "direct our way".

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting. Literal keeps the article: "the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}".

decisions.choice: understand more and more how much God loves you; keep going with patience, as {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} did
alternatives: into the love of God and into the endurance of Christ
decisions.reason: Readable states the sense chosen in m1, which is uncertain.

decisions.choice: "하나님의 사랑과 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 인내" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads these as God's love for them and the endurance Christ showed and gives, and marks it uncertain. Korean "...의 사랑", "...의 인내" keep the Greek's open genitives at Literal and Balanced; Readable says the reading chosen, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "tình yêu thương của Đức Chúa Trời", "sự kiên trì của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}" (L, B)
alternatives: "tình yêu đối với Đức Chúa Trời"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads these as God's love for them and the endurance Christ showed and gives, with other readings noted (m1). Literal and Balanced keep "của", which leaves the phrase as open as the Greek; Readable says what the meaning decision reads.

decisions.choice: {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} (of the Christ, of the Messiah), with the definite "መሲሑ"
decisions.reason: The Greek has the article here, so the alternative takes the definite form, as the style brief sets for Christ with a prefix.

decisions.choice: "मसीह" with no christos setting
decisions.reason: "मसीह" is both the familiar name and the word Messiah itself, so the choice the English setting offers is already made (style guide, section 7). The same through this chapter.

source.text: Παραγγέλλομεν δὲ ὑμῖν, ἀδελφοί, ἐν ὀνόματι τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ στέλλεσθαι ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ παντὸς ἀδελφοῦ ἀτάκτως περιπατοῦντος καὶ μὴ κατὰ τὴν παράδοσιν ἣν παρελάβοσαν παρ’ ἡμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: We command now you, brothers, in [the] name of the Lord of us Jesus Christ to keep away you from every brother disorderly walking and not according to the tradition which they received from us.

en.L: Now we command you, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, in [the] name of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, to keep away from every {{gender:brother or sister|brother}} who walks in a disorderly way and not according to the tradition that they received from us.
en.B: {{gender:Brothers and sisters|Brothers}}, in the name of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} we command you: keep your distance from any {{gender:brother or sister|brother}} who lives an undisciplined life, contrary to the tradition they received from us.
en.R: {{gender:Brothers and sisters|Brothers}}, we give you this command with the authority of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}: stay away from any believer who refuses to work and does not live the way we taught.

fr.L: Or nous vous ordonnons, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, au nom de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, de vous tenir à l’écart de {{gender:tout frère ou toute sœur|tout frère}} qui marche de manière désordonnée et non selon la tradition qu’ils ont reçue de nous.
fr.B: {{gender:Frères et sœurs|Frères}}, au nom de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, nous vous l’ordonnons : tenez-vous à distance de {{gender:tout frère ou toute sœur|tout frère}} qui mène une vie déréglée, contraire à la tradition qu’ils ont reçue de nous.
fr.R: {{gender:Frères et sœurs|Frères}}, nous vous donnons cet ordre avec l’autorité de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} : éloignez-vous de tout membre de l’église qui refuse de travailler et qui ne vit pas comme nous l’avons enseigné.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:les|os}} mandamos, hermanos, en [el] nombre de nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}, que {{plural_you:se aparten|os apartéis}} de {{gender:todo hermano o hermana|todo hermano}} que vive de manera indisciplinada y no conforme a la tradición que recibieron de nosotros.
es.B: Hermanos, en el nombre de nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}} {{plural_you:les|os}} mandamos: {{plural_you:apártense|apartaos}} de {{gender:cualquier hermano o hermana|cualquier hermano}} que lleve una vida indisciplinada, contraria a la tradición que recibieron de nosotros.
es.R: Hermanos, {{plural_you:les|os}} damos esta orden con la autoridad de nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}: {{plural_you:apártense|apartaos}} de cualquier creyente que se niegue a trabajar y no viva como nosotros enseñamos.

sw.L: Basi tunawaagiza, ndugu, katika jina la Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, mjitenge na kila ndugu anayeenenda bila utaratibu, wala si kulingana na mapokeo waliyoyapokea kutoka kwetu.
sw.B: Ndugu, kwa jina la Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} tunawaagiza: kaeni mbali na ndugu yeyote anayeishi maisha yasiyo na nidhamu, kinyume na mapokeo waliyoyapokea kutoka kwetu.
sw.R: Ndugu, tunawapa agizo hili kwa mamlaka ya Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}: kaeni mbali na mwamini yeyote anayekataa kufanya kazi, na asiyeishi kama tulivyowafundisha.

ko.L: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 우리가 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 이름으로 여러분에게 명령합니다. 무질서하게 걷고, 우리에게서 받은 전통을 따르지 않는 모든 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}를 멀리하십시오.
ko.B: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 이름으로 여러분에게 명령합니다. 규모 없이 살며 우리에게서 받은 전통을 따르지 않는 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}는 누구든지 멀리하십시오.
ko.R: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 우리는 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 권위로 여러분에게 이렇게 명령합니다. 일하기를 거부하고 우리가 가르친 대로 살지 않는 믿는 사람은 누구든지 멀리하십시오.

vi.L: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, nhân danh Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, chúng tôi truyền cho anh chị em phải tránh xa mọi {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} nào sống vô trật tự và không theo truyền thống mà họ đã nhận từ chúng tôi.
vi.B: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, nhân danh Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, chúng tôi truyền cho anh chị em: hãy giữ khoảng cách với bất cứ {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} nào sống không theo khuôn phép, trái với truyền thống mà họ đã nhận từ chúng tôi.
vi.R: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, chúng tôi truyền cho anh chị em mệnh lệnh này với thẩm quyền của Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}: hãy tránh xa bất cứ tín hữu nào không chịu làm việc và không sống theo cách chúng tôi đã dạy.

pt.L: Ora, ordenamos a vocês, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, em nome do nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}, que se afastem de {{gender:qualquer irmão ou irmã|todo irmão}} que anda de modo desordenado e não segundo a tradição que receberam de nós.
pt.B: {{gender:Irmãos e irmãs|Irmãos}}, em nome do nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}, nós lhes ordenamos: mantenham distância de {{gender:qualquer irmão ou irmã|qualquer irmão}} que leve uma vida indisciplinada, contrária à tradição que receberam de nós.
pt.R: {{gender:Irmãos e irmãs|Irmãos}}, damos a vocês esta ordem com a autoridade do nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}: fiquem longe de qualquer membro da igreja que se recusa a trabalhar e não vive do jeito que nós ensinamos.

am.L: {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ስም እናዝዛችኋለን፤ ያለ ሥርዓት ከሚመላለስና ከእኛ እንደ ተቀበሉት ትውፊት ከማይኖር {{gender:ወንድም ወይም እኅት|ወንድም}} ሁሉ ራቁ።
am.B: {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ስም እናዝዛችኋለን፤ ሥርዓት በሌለው ኑሮ ከሚኖርና ከእኛ የተቀበሉትን ትውፊት ከማይከተል {{gender:ወንድም ወይም እኅት|ወንድም}} ሁሉ ራቁ።
am.R: {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ሥልጣን ይህን ትእዛዝ እንሰጣችኋለን፤ መሥራት እንቢ ካለና እኛ ባስተማርነው መንገድ ከማይኖር አማኝ ሁሉ ራቁ።

hi.L: हे {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}, हम तुम्हें अपने प्रभु यीशु मसीह के नाम से आज्ञा देते हैं कि हर एक ऐसे {{gender:भाई या बहन|भाई}} से अलग रहो जो बेढंगी चाल चलता है, और उस परंपरा के अनुसार नहीं जो उन्होंने हमसे पाई।
hi.B: {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}, हम अपने प्रभु यीशु मसीह के नाम से तुम्हें आज्ञा देते हैं: हर उस {{gender:भाई या बहन|भाई}} से दूर रहो जो अनुशासनहीन जीवन बिताता है, उस परंपरा के विरुद्ध जो उन्होंने हमसे पाई।
hi.R: {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}, हम अपने प्रभु यीशु मसीह के अधिकार से तुम्हें यह आज्ञा देते हैं: हर उस विश्वासी से दूर रहो जो काम करने से इनकार करता है, और उस तरह नहीं जीता जैसे हमने सिखाया।

ru.L: Повелеваем же вам, {{gender:братья и сёстры|братья}}, именем Господа нашего Иисуса {{christos:Христа|Мессии}} удаляться от {{gender:всякого брата или сестры|всякого брата}}, ходящего беспорядочно, а не по преданию, которое они приняли от нас.
ru.B: {{gender:Братья и сёстры|Братья}}, именем нашего Господа Иисуса {{christos:Христа|Мессии}} мы повелеваем вам: держитесь подальше от {{gender:всякого брата или сестры|всякого брата}}, кто живёт беспорядочно, вопреки преданию, которое они получили от нас.
ru.R: {{gender:Братья и сёстры|Братья}}, мы даём вам это повеление властью нашего Господа Иисуса {{christos:Христа|Мессии}}: держитесь подальше от любого верующего, который отказывается работать и живёт не так, как мы учили.

ja.L: {{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、わたしたちの主イエス・{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の名によって、あなたがたに命じます。秩序を乱して歩み、わたしたちから受けた伝承に従わないすべての{{gender:きょうだい|兄弟}}から離れなさい。
ja.B: {{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、わたしたちの主イエス・{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の名によって命じます。勝手な生活をして、わたしたちから受け継いだ教えのとおりに生きていない{{gender:きょうだい|兄弟}}がいれば、だれであっても、その人から遠ざかりなさい。
ja.R: {{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、わたしたちの主イエス・{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の権威によって、みなさんに命じます。働こうとせず、わたしたちが教えたとおりに生きていない信者がいたら、その人から離れていてください。

uk.L: Наказуємо ж вам, {{gender:брати і сестри|брати}}, в імʼя нашого Господа Ісуса {{christos:Христа|Месії}} сторонитися всякого {{gender:брата чи сестри|брата}}, що ходить безладно, а не за переданням, яке вони прийняли від нас.
uk.B: {{gender:Брати і сестри|Брати}}, в імʼя нашого Господа Ісуса {{christos:Христа|Месії}} ми наказуємо вам: тримайтеся осторонь кожного {{gender:брата чи сестри|брата}}, який живе безладно, всупереч переданню, яке вони прийняли від нас.
uk.R: {{gender:Брати і сестри|Брати}}, ми даємо вам цей наказ владою нашого Господа Ісуса {{christos:Христа|Месії}}: тримайтеся осторонь кожного віруючого, який не хоче працювати і не живе так, як ми навчали.

decisions.choice: disorderly: out of line, here refusing to work
decisions.reason: ἀτάκτως is the adverb of the word in 1 Thessalonians 5:14, used of soldiers out of rank or of failing to show up for work. Verses 7-12 make the meaning plain here: some members had stopped working and were living off others.

decisions.choice: keep away from: draw back from close fellowship
decisions.reason: στέλλομαι means to hold oneself aloof, to avoid. It is not expelling them as enemies (verse 15) but refusing to support their way of life.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "they received"
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts read "you received". The SBLGNT reads the plural "they", referring to the disorderly members. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: the tradition: Paul's teaching, here about work
decisions.reason: As in 2:15, the teaching handed on, including the instruction about work of verse 10.

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: The letter is to the whole church, women and men; "brothers" stays available as the traditional form.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: {{gender:brother or sister|brother}}
decisions.reason: Any member, man or woman; "brother" is the traditional form. Readable says "believer".

decisions.choice: refuses to work
decisions.reason: Readable states the sense the context gives (m1).

decisions.choice: {{gender:tout frère ou toute sœur|tout frère}} (L, B); tout membre de l’église (R)
decisions.reason: "Tout" agrees with each noun, so the span covers it. Readable's "tout membre de l’église" already includes everyone, as the English "believer" does.

decisions.choice: de manera indisciplinada (L); una vida indisciplinada (B); se niega a trabajar (R)
decisions.reason: The same word family as 1 Thessalonians 5:14, "indisciplinados": living out of line, here by refusing to work (meaning decision). Readable says what it meant in practice, as the English does. The same in verses 7 and 11.

decisions.choice: {{gender:todo hermano o hermana|todo hermano}} (L); {{gender:cualquier hermano o hermana|cualquier hermano}} (B)
decisions.reason: A singular "hermano" names a man, so, as in 1 Thessalonians 4:6, Spanish keeps the English gender setting here and in verse 15.

decisions.choice: bila utaratibu (L); maisha yasiyo na nidhamu (B); anayekataa kufanya kazi (R)
decisions.reason: The same word family as 1 Thessalonians 5:14 ("wasio na utaratibu"). Here verses 7-11 show what the disorder is, refusing to work, so Balanced says "bila nidhamu" (undisciplined) and Readable says it outright, as the English does. "Ndugu" already includes sisters, so there is no gender span.

decisions.choice: "무질서하게" (L); "규모 없이" (B); "일하기를 거부하고" (R), here and in verses 7 and 11
decisions.reason: The word means out of line, and here refusing to work (the meaning decision). Literal keeps the word used in 1 Thessalonians 5:14; Balanced says "규모 없이" (without order or discipline in one's life); Readable says what it was, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} for the singular "brother" (L, B); "믿는 사람" (R), here and in verse 15
decisions.reason: As in 1 Thessalonians 4:6: any fellow believer, man or woman, so the span is used; Readable says "믿는 사람", which needs no setting.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} nào" (L, B) for one fellow believer; "tín hữu nào" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Thessalonians 4:6 and the Vietnamese Romans (14:10): Vietnamese does not mark number here, so the span for believers reads naturally of any one of them.

decisions.choice: "vô trật tự" (L); "không theo khuôn phép" (B); "không chịu làm việc" (R) (also 3:7, 11)
decisions.reason: The word is out of line, here refusing to work (m1). Literal and Balanced keep the words of 1 Thessalonians 5:14 for the same Greek word, so the reader sees that Paul returns to it; Readable says what it means here, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: qualquer membro da igreja
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "believer". "Irmão na fé" is masculine, and "crente" in Brazil usually means a Protestant; "membro da igreja" covers men and women without a setting.

decisions.choice: {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ
decisions.reason: Paul's word for the believers he writes to includes the sisters, so the default names both and the alternative keeps the traditional "ወንድሞች". The vocative "ሆይ" stands outside the span because both options take it; a case prefix goes inside each option. This holds through the chapter.

decisions.choice: {{gender:ወንድም ወይም እኅት|ወንድም}} (a brother or sister, or a brother), with the case prefix on the relative verb before it
decisions.reason: The believer who will not work may be a man or a woman. Amharic puts "ከ-" (from) on the first word of the phrase, the relative verb, so the noun in the span is bare; Readable says "any believer" ("አማኝ ሁሉ"), as the English does.

decisions.choice: {{gender:भाई या बहन|भाई}} (L, B); "विश्वासी" (R)
decisions.reason: Any member, man or woman, is meant, so the inclusive singular is the default. Readable says believer, which needs no setting, as the English does. The same in verse 15.

decisions.choice: "बेढंगी चाल चलता है" (L); "अनुशासनहीन जीवन" (B); "काम करने से इनकार करता है" (R)
decisions.reason: Disorderly means out of line, here refusing to work (meaning decision m1); Literal keeps the walk and the disorder, as in 1 Thessalonians 5:14, and Readable says what it is.

decisions.choice: {{gender:всякого брата или сестры|всякого брата}}
decisions.reason: As in English: any member, man or woman, is meant. The adjective goes inside each option so that it agrees under both; Readable says "верующего".

decisions.choice: "秩序を乱して歩み" (L); "勝手な生活をして" (B); "働こうとせず" (R), and the same family at 3:7 and 3:11
decisions.reason: The word is the one rendered at 1 Thessalonians 5:14; here it means being out of line by refusing to work (m1). Literal and Balanced keep the forms used there so the link stays visible; Readable names the refusal to work, as the English does.

decisions.choice: безладно (L, B); не хоче працювати (R)
decisions.reason: The same word group as 1 Thessalonians 5:14, kept as "безладні"; here the meaning decision says the disorder is refusing to work, which Readable says plainly.

source.text: αὐτοὶ γὰρ οἴδατε πῶς δεῖ μιμεῖσθαι ἡμᾶς, ὅτι οὐκ ἠτακτήσαμεν ἐν ὑμῖν οὐδὲ δωρεὰν ἄρτον ἐφάγομεν παρά τινος, ἀλλ’ ἐν κόπῳ καὶ μόχθῳ νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας ἐργαζόμενοι πρὸς τὸ μὴ ἐπιβαρῆσαί τινα ὑμῶν·

records.literal_gloss: Yourselves for you know how it is necessary to imitate us, because not we were disorderly among you \v 8 nor freely bread we ate from anyone, but in labor and toil night and day working so as not to burden any of you;

en.L: For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us, because we were not disorderly among you, \v 8 nor did we eat bread from anyone without paying, but with labor and toil, working night and day, so as not to be a burden to any of you.
en.B: You know yourselves that you should imitate us. We did not live idly among you, \v 8 and we never ate anyone's bread as a gift; we labored and toiled, working night and day, so as not to be a burden to any of you.
en.R: You know that you should live the way we lived. We were not lazy when we were with you. \v 8 We did not eat anyone's food without paying for it. We worked hard day and night, so that we would not be a burden to any of you.

fr.L: Car vous-mêmes savez comment il faut nous imiter, parce que nous n’avons pas été désordonnés parmi vous, \v 8 et nous n’avons mangé gratuitement le pain de personne, mais dans le labeur et la peine, travaillant nuit et jour pour n’être à charge à aucun de vous.
fr.B: Vous savez vous-mêmes que vous devez nous imiter. Nous n’avons pas vécu dans l’oisiveté parmi vous, \v 8 et nous n’avons jamais mangé gratuitement le pain de personne ; nous avons travaillé et peiné nuit et jour pour n’être à la charge d’aucun de vous.
fr.R: Vous savez que vous devez vivre comme nous avons vécu. Nous n’avons pas été paresseux quand nous étions avec vous. \v 8 Nous n’avons mangé chez personne sans payer. Nous avons travaillé dur jour et nuit, pour n’être à la charge d’aucun de vous.

es.L: Porque {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} mismos {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} cómo {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} imitarnos, porque no vivimos de manera indisciplinada entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, \v 8 ni comimos de balde el pan de nadie, sino que con trabajo y fatiga, trabajando de noche y de día, para no ser una carga a ninguno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes mismos saben|Vosotros mismos sabéis}} que {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} imitarnos. No vivimos ociosamente entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, \v 8 ni comimos gratis el pan de nadie; trabajamos y nos fatigamos de noche y de día, para no ser una carga a ninguno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} vivir como nosotros vivimos. No fuimos perezosos cuando estábamos con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. \v 8 No comimos la comida de nadie sin pagarla. Trabajamos duro día y noche para no ser una carga a ninguno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana ninyi wenyewe mnajua jinsi iwapasavyo kutuiga, kwa sababu hatukuwa bila utaratibu kati yenu, \v 8 wala hatukula mkate wa mtu yeyote bure, bali kwa juhudi na taabu, tukifanya kazi usiku na mchana, ili tusimlemee yeyote kati yenu.
sw.B: Ninyi wenyewe mnajua kwamba mnapaswa kutuiga. Hatukuishi kivivu kati yenu, \v 8 wala hatukula chakula cha mtu yeyote bila kulipa; tulifanya kazi kwa juhudi na taabu usiku na mchana, ili tusimlemee yeyote kati yenu.
sw.R: Mnajua kwamba mnapaswa kuishi kama sisi tulivyoishi. Hatukuwa wavivu tulipokuwa pamoja nanyi. \v 8 Hatukula chakula cha mtu yeyote bila kukilipia. Tulifanya kazi kwa bidii mchana na usiku, ili tusiwe mzigo kwa yeyote kati yenu.

ko.L: 여러분이 우리를 어떻게 본받아야 하는지 여러분 자신이 압니다. 우리는 여러분 가운데서 무질서하게 행하지 않았고, \v 8 누구에게서도 값없이 빵을 얻어먹지 않았으며, 여러분 가운데 아무에게도 짐이 되지 않으려고 수고하고 애쓰며 밤낮으로 일했습니다.
ko.B: 여러분은 우리를 본받아야 한다는 것을 잘 알고 있습니다. 우리는 여러분 가운데서 빈둥거리며 살지 않았습니다. \v 8 우리는 누구의 빵도 거저 먹지 않았습니다. 오히려 여러분 가운데 누구에게도 짐이 되지 않으려고 수고하고 애쓰며 밤낮으로 일했습니다.
ko.R: 여러분은 우리가 산 것처럼 살아야 한다는 것을 압니다. 우리는 여러분과 함께 있을 때 게으르지 않았습니다. \v 8 우리는 누구의 음식도 값을 치르지 않고 먹지 않았습니다. 우리는 여러분 가운데 누구에게도 짐이 되지 않으려고 밤낮으로 열심히 일했습니다.

vi.L: Vì chính anh chị em biết anh chị em phải bắt chước chúng tôi thế nào, vì chúng tôi đã không sống vô trật tự giữa anh chị em, \v 8 cũng không ăn bánh của ai mà không trả tiền, nhưng làm việc lao nhọc và vất vả cả ngày lẫn đêm, để khỏi làm gánh nặng cho một ai trong anh chị em;
vi.B: Chính anh chị em biết rằng anh chị em phải noi gương chúng tôi. Chúng tôi đã không sống nhàn rỗi giữa anh chị em, \v 8 và chúng tôi chưa bao giờ ăn bánh của ai mà không trả tiền. Chúng tôi đã lao nhọc và vất vả, làm việc cả ngày lẫn đêm, để khỏi làm gánh nặng cho bất cứ ai trong anh chị em.
vi.R: Anh chị em biết rằng anh chị em nên sống như chúng tôi đã sống. Chúng tôi đã không lười biếng khi ở với anh chị em. \v 8 Chúng tôi không ăn thức ăn của ai mà không trả tiền. Chúng tôi đã làm việc vất vả cả ngày lẫn đêm, để không trở thành gánh nặng cho ai trong anh chị em.

pt.L: Pois vocês mesmos sabem como devem nos imitar, porque não fomos desordenados entre vocês, \v 8 nem comemos de graça o pão de ninguém, mas com trabalho e fadiga, trabalhando noite e dia, para não sermos um peso para nenhum de vocês.
pt.B: Vocês mesmos sabem que devem nos imitar. Não vivemos no ócio entre vocês, \v 8 e nunca comemos de graça o pão de ninguém; trabalhamos com esforço e cansaço, noite e dia, para não sermos um peso para nenhum de vocês.
pt.R: Vocês sabem que devem viver como nós vivemos. Não fomos preguiçosos quando estávamos com vocês. \v 8 Não comemos a comida de ninguém sem pagar. Trabalhamos duro, dia e noite, para não sermos um peso para nenhum de vocês.

am.L: እኛን ልትመስሉ እንዴት እንደሚገባችሁ እናንተ ራሳችሁ ታውቃላችሁና፤ በመካከላችሁ ያለ ሥርዓት አልኖርንምና፤ \v 8 የማንንም እንጀራ በነጻ አልበላንም፤ ነገር ግን ከእናንተ በማንም ላይ ሸክም እንዳንሆን በድካምና በልፋት ሌሊትና ቀን እየሠራን [ኖርን]።
am.B: እኛን ልትመስሉ እንደሚገባችሁ ራሳችሁ ታውቃላችሁ። በመካከላችሁ ሥራ ፈቶች አልነበርንም፤ \v 8 የማንንም እንጀራ በነጻ ከቶ አልበላንም፤ ይልቁንም ከእናንተ በማንም ላይ ሸክም እንዳንሆን ሌሊትና ቀን ሠራን፤ ደከምን፤ ለፋንም።
am.R: እኛ እንደ ኖርን መኖር እንዳለባችሁ ታውቃላችሁ። ከእናንተ ጋር በነበርን ጊዜ ሰነፎች አልነበርንም። \v 8 የማንንም ምግብ ሳንከፍል አልበላንም። ከእናንተ በማንም ላይ ሸክም እንዳንሆን ቀንና ሌሊት ተግተን ሠራን።

hi.L: क्योंकि तुम आप जानते हो कि तुम्हें हमारी नक़ल कैसे करनी चाहिए, क्योंकि हम तुम्हारे बीच बेढंगी चाल न चले, \v 8 और किसी की रोटी मुफ़्त में न खाई, पर परिश्रम और कष्ट से रात-दिन काम करते रहे, कि तुममें से किसी पर बोझ न हों।
hi.B: तुम स्वयं जानते हो कि तुम्हें हमारे उदाहरण पर चलना चाहिए। हम तुम्हारे बीच निकम्मे होकर नहीं रहे, \v 8 और हमने कभी किसी की रोटी मुफ़्त में नहीं खाई; हमने परिश्रम और कष्ट उठाकर रात-दिन काम किया, ताकि तुममें से किसी पर बोझ न बनें।
hi.R: तुम जानते हो कि तुम्हें वैसे ही जीना चाहिए जैसे हम जिए। जब हम तुम्हारे साथ थे, तब हम आलसी नहीं थे। \v 8 हमने किसी का खाना बिना पैसे दिए नहीं खाया। हमने दिन-रात कड़ी मेहनत की, ताकि तुममें से किसी पर बोझ न बनें।

ru.L: Ведь вы сами знаете, как должно подражать нам, потому что мы не жили беспорядочно у вас \v 8 и ни у кого не ели хлеба даром, но в труде и тяготах ночью и днём работали, чтобы не обременить никого из вас;
ru.B: Вы сами знаете, что вам следует подражать нам. Мы не жили среди вас праздно \v 8 и никогда не ели ни у кого хлеба даром; мы трудились и работали ночью и днём, чтобы не быть в тягость никому из вас.
ru.R: Вы знаете, что вам нужно жить так, как жили мы. Мы не ленились, когда были у вас. \v 8 Мы ни у кого не ели еду, не заплатив за неё. Мы усердно работали днём и ночью, чтобы не быть обузой ни для кого из вас.

ja.L: あなたがた自身が、どのようにわたしたちに倣うべきかを知っているからです。わたしたちは、あなたがたの間で秩序を乱すことはせず、\v 8 だれかからただでパンを食べることもせず、むしろ、あなたがたのだれにも負担をかけないように、労苦と骨折りのうちに夜も昼も働いたのです。
ja.B: あなたがた自身、わたしたちに倣うべきことを知っています。わたしたちは、あなたがたの間で怠けて暮らしたことはなく、\v 8 だれのパンも、ただで食べたことはありません。かえって、あなたがたのだれにも負担をかけないように、苦労して骨折り、夜も昼も働いたのです。
ja.R: みなさんは、わたしたちと同じように生きるべきだと知っています。わたしたちは、みなさんと一緒にいたとき、怠けてはいませんでした。\v 8 だれかの食べ物を、お金を払わずに食べたこともありません。みなさんのだれの重荷にもならないように、昼も夜も一生懸命に働きました。

uk.L: Бо ви самі знаєте, як вам слід наслідувати нас, бо ми не жили безладно серед вас, \v 8 і ні в кого даром хліба не їли, а в праці й труді, вночі й удень працюючи, щоб не обтяжити нікого з вас.
uk.B: Ви самі знаєте, що вам слід наслідувати нас. Ми не байдикували серед вас \v 8 і ніколи не їли ні в кого хліба задарма; ми трудилися й мучилися, працюючи вночі й удень, щоб не бути тягарем нікому з вас.
uk.R: Ви знаєте, що вам слід жити так, як жили ми. Ми не лінувалися, коли були з вами. \v 8 Ми ні в кого не їли їжі, не заплативши за неї. Ми тяжко працювали день і ніч, щоб не бути тягарем нікому з вас.

decisions.choice: we were not disorderly: we did not shirk work
decisions.reason: ἀτακτέω is the verb of the word in verse 6.

decisions.choice: eat bread freely: live at someone else's expense
decisions.reason: "To eat bread" means to earn one's living (Genesis 3:19); "freely" means without paying.

decisions.choice: labor and toil, night and day
decisions.reason: The same words as 1 Thessalonians 2:9: Paul supported himself by his trade (Acts 18:3).

decisions.choice: live idly (B); lazy (R)
decisions.reason: Here the context makes the sense of "disorderly" plain (verse 6, m1).

decisions.choice: comimos de balde el pan de nadie
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek "eat bread freely", an idiom for living at someone else's expense (meaning decision); "de balde" is the Spanish for "for nothing".
The style guide gives "빵" for bread, never "떡". To eat bread freely is to live at someone else's expense (the meaning decision); Readable says "음식" (food), as the English Readable says "food".

decisions.choice: እንጀራ (bread, L, B); ምግብ (food, R), here and in verse 12
decisions.reason: "To eat bread" means to live on food someone provides, and the style brief keeps "እንጀራ" for bread as food; Readable says "food", as the English Readable does.

source.text: οὐχ ὅτι οὐκ ἔχομεν ἐξουσίαν, ἀλλ’ ἵνα ἑαυτοὺς τύπον δῶμεν ὑμῖν εἰς τὸ μιμεῖσθαι ἡμᾶς.

records.literal_gloss: not that not we have right, but so that ourselves [as] an example we might give to you so as to imitate us.

en.L: Not that we do not have the right, but so that we might give ourselves to you as an example to imitate.
en.B: It was not that we had no right to support, but we wanted to give you an example to follow.
en.R: We had the right to ask you for help, but we did not do it. We wanted to show you how to live, so that you would live the same way.

fr.L: Non que nous n’ayons pas le droit, mais pour nous donner nous-mêmes à vous en modèle à imiter.
fr.B: Ce n’est pas que nous n’ayons pas le droit d’être entretenus, mais nous voulions vous donner un exemple à suivre.
fr.R: Nous avions le droit de vous demander de l’aide, mais nous ne l’avons pas fait. Nous voulions vous montrer comment vivre, pour que vous viviez de la même manière.

es.L: No porque no tengamos derecho, sino para dar{{plural_you:les|os}} en nosotros mismos un ejemplo para que nos imiten.
es.B: No es que no tuviéramos derecho a ser sostenidos, sino que quisimos dar{{plural_you:les|os}} un ejemplo que seguir.
es.R: Teníamos derecho a pedir{{plural_you:les|os}} ayuda, pero no lo hicimos. Queríamos mostrar{{plural_you:les|os}} cómo vivir, para que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:vivieran|vivierais}} de la misma manera.

sw.L: Si kwamba hatuna haki, bali ili tujitoe kwenu kuwa kielelezo, mpate kutuiga.
sw.B: Haikuwa kwamba hatukuwa na haki ya kusaidiwa, bali tulitaka kuwapa mfano wa kufuata.
sw.R: Tulikuwa na haki ya kuwaomba msaada, lakini hatukufanya hivyo. Tulitaka kuwaonyesha jinsi ya kuishi, ili nanyi mwishi vivyo hivyo.

ko.L: 우리에게 권리가 없어서가 아니라, 우리 자신을 여러분에게 본으로 주어 여러분이 우리를 본받게 하려는 것이었습니다.
ko.B: 우리에게 도움을 받을 권리가 없어서가 아니었습니다. 우리는 여러분에게 본을 보여 여러분이 따르게 하려고 했습니다.
ko.R: 우리에게는 여러분에게 도움을 청할 권리가 있었지만, 그렇게 하지 않았습니다. 우리는 여러분에게 어떻게 살아야 하는지 보여 주어서, 여러분도 그렇게 살게 하고 싶었습니다.

vi.L: không phải vì chúng tôi không có quyền, nhưng để làm gương cho anh chị em bắt chước chúng tôi.
vi.B: Không phải vì chúng tôi không có quyền được giúp đỡ, nhưng chúng tôi muốn làm gương cho anh chị em noi theo.
vi.R: Chúng tôi có quyền xin anh chị em giúp đỡ, nhưng chúng tôi đã không làm vậy. Chúng tôi muốn cho anh chị em thấy cách sống, để anh chị em sống giống như vậy.

pt.L: Não que não tenhamos o direito, mas para nos darmos a vocês como exemplo, para que nos imitem.
pt.B: Não que não tivéssemos direito ao sustento, mas quisemos dar a vocês um exemplo a seguir.
pt.R: Nós tínhamos o direito de pedir ajuda a vocês, mas não fizemos isso. Queríamos mostrar a vocês como viver, para que vocês vivessem do mesmo jeito.

am.L: ይህም መብት ስለሌለን አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን ልትመስሉን ራሳችንን ምሳሌ አድርገን እንድንሰጣችሁ ነው።
am.B: ይህን ያደረግነው ድጋፍ የማግኘት መብት ስለሌለን አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን የምትከተሉት ምሳሌ ልንሰጣችሁ ፈልገን ነው።
am.R: እርዳታ እንድትሰጡን ልንጠይቃችሁ መብት ነበረን፤ ግን አላደረግነውም። እንዴት መኖር እንዳለባችሁ ልናሳያችሁ ፈለግን፤ ይህም እናንተም እንዲሁ እንድትኖሩ ነው።

hi.L: यह नहीं कि हमें अधिकार नहीं, पर इसलिए कि अपने आप को तुम्हारे लिए नमूना ठहराएँ कि तुम हमारी सी चाल चलो।
hi.B: ऐसा नहीं था कि हमें सहायता पाने का अधिकार नहीं था, पर हम तुम्हें एक उदाहरण देना चाहते थे जिस पर तुम चलो।
hi.R: हमें तुमसे सहायता माँगने का अधिकार था, पर हमने ऐसा नहीं किया। हम तुम्हें दिखाना चाहते थे कि कैसे जीना है, ताकि तुम भी वैसे ही जियो।

ru.L: Не потому, что мы не имеем права, но чтобы дать вам себя в образец для подражания нам.
ru.B: Не то чтобы у нас не было права на содержание, но мы хотели дать вам пример, которому можно следовать.
ru.R: У нас было право просить вас о помощи, но мы этого не сделали. Мы хотели показать вам, как жить, чтобы вы жили так же.

ja.L: それは、わたしたちに権利がないからではなく、あなたがたがわたしたちに倣うように、自分自身をあなたがたへの模範として示すためでした。
ja.B: それは、わたしたちに支えを受ける権利がなかったからではありません。あなたがたが倣うことのできる模範を示したかったのです。
ja.R: わたしたちには、みなさんに助けてほしいと頼む権利がありました。でも、そうはしませんでした。みなさんにどう生きればよいかを見せて、みなさんにも同じように生きてほしかったのです。

uk.L: Не тому, що не маємо права, а щоб себе самих дати вам за взірець, щоб ви наслідували нас.
uk.B: Не тому, що ми не мали права на утримання, а тому, що хотіли дати вам приклад, щоб ви йшли за ним.
uk.R: Ми мали право просити у вас допомоги, але не робили цього. Ми хотіли показати вам, як жити, щоб ви жили так само.

decisions.choice: the right: the right to be supported by those they served
decisions.reason: Paul argues for this right at length in 1 Corinthians 9:4-14, and gives it up for the sake of the gospel.

decisions.choice: the right to support
decisions.reason: Balanced says what the right was (m1).

decisions.choice: haki (exousia, a right)
decisions.reason: Here the word is a right, Paul's right to be supported, so Swahili says "haki" in its everyday sense of a right one may claim. The project's term list keeps "haki" for righteousness and gives "ruhusa" or "mamlaka" for this word, but neither says "a right to support" naturally; for review by a native speaker.

source.text: καὶ γὰρ ὅτε ἦμεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς, τοῦτο παρηγγέλλομεν ὑμῖν, ὅτι εἴ τις οὐ θέλει ἐργάζεσθαι μηδὲ ἐσθιέτω.

records.literal_gloss: And indeed when we were with you, this we were commanding you, that if anyone not is willing to work, neither let him eat.

en.L: For even when we were with you, we kept giving you this command: "If anyone is not willing to work, neither should [that person] eat."
en.B: For even while we were with you, we gave you this instruction: "Anyone who will not work should not eat."
en.R: When we were with you, we gave you this rule: "If someone does not want to work, they should not eat."

fr.L: Et en effet, quand nous étions auprès de vous, nous vous donnions cet ordre : « Si quelqu’un ne veut pas travailler, qu’il ne mange pas non plus. »
fr.B: Car déjà lorsque nous étions chez vous, nous vous avons donné cette règle : « Celui qui ne veut pas travailler ne doit pas manger non plus. »
fr.R: Quand nous étions avec vous, nous vous avons donné cette règle : « Si quelqu’un ne veut pas travailler, il ne doit pas manger. »

es.L: Porque también cuando estábamos con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} ordenábamos esto: «Si alguno no quiere trabajar, que tampoco coma».
es.B: Ya cuando estábamos con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} dimos esta instrucción: «El que no quiera trabajar, que no coma».
es.R: Cuando estábamos con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} dimos esta regla: «Si alguien no quiere trabajar, que no coma».

sw.R: Tulipokuwa pamoja nanyi, tuliwapa kanuni hii: "Mtu asiyetaka kufanya kazi hapaswi kula."

ko.L: 우리가 여러분과 함께 있을 때에도 여러분에게 "누구든지 일하려고 하지 않으면 먹지도 말아야 한다" 하고 명령하곤 했습니다.
ko.B: 우리가 여러분과 함께 있을 때에도 여러분에게 이렇게 지시했습니다. "일하기 싫어하는 사람은 먹지도 말아야 한다."
ko.R: 우리는 여러분과 함께 있을 때 이런 규칙을 주었습니다. "일하기 싫어하는 사람은 먹지도 말아야 한다."

vi.B: Vì ngay khi còn ở với anh chị em, chúng tôi đã dặn bảo anh chị em điều này: "Ai không chịu làm việc thì đừng ăn."
vi.R: Khi ở với anh chị em, chúng tôi đã cho anh chị em quy tắc này: "Nếu ai không muốn làm việc, thì người ấy không nên ăn."

pt.L: Pois também, quando estávamos com vocês, nós lhes ordenávamos isto: "Se alguém não quer trabalhar, que também não coma."
pt.B: Pois, mesmo quando estávamos com vocês, nós lhes demos esta instrução: "Quem não quer trabalhar não deve comer."
pt.R: Quando estávamos com vocês, demos a vocês esta regra: "Se alguém não quer trabalhar, não deve comer."

am.B: ከእናንተ ጋር ሳለንም እንኳ ይህን ትእዛዝ ሰጥተናችሁ ነበር፦ «መሥራት የማይፈልግ አይብላ።»

hi.B: क्योंकि जब हम तुम्हारे साथ थे, तब भी हमने तुम्हें यह निर्देश दिया था: "जो काम नहीं करना चाहता, वह खाने भी न पाए।"
